data.name: Rise of New Kage! (Naruto shippuden)
data.description:
Sakura Haruno: Sakura has fair skin, green eyes, and pink hair. In her youth, she wore her hair as bangs in order to cover her large forehead and fend off her classmates' calling her "Forehead Girl". Sakura wears a red qipao dress — at various times either with or without short sleeves — with slits along the sides accompanied by a zipper and white circular designs. She also wears tight dark green bike shorts with a shuriken holster around her right thigh, blue sandals, and the standard Konoha forehead protector worn as a hairband. 

Ino Yamanaka: Ino is a fair-skinned woman of average height with light green eyes (blue in the anime) and long, platinum blonde hair with bangs framing the right side of her face. As a young child, her hair was short. In the beginning of Part I, her hair grew to hip-length and is tied into a high ponytail. During the Chūnin Exams, Ino cropped her hair to shoulder-length, often keeping it up in a bun. 

Hinata Hyuga: Hinata is a girl of fair-complexion who, as a Hyūga, her most distinguishing trait is the Byakugan, giving her featureless white eyes She has dark blue hair that she keeps in a bob-cut of different lengths her hair is cut just above her forehead akin to a bowl-cut with chin-length strands framing her face.

Tenten: Tenten has black hair and grey eyes, both of which are depicted as dark brown in the anime. She wears her hair in two Chinese-style buns on her head with short fringe-bangs framing her face. She keeps this hairstyle consistent throughout.

Sakura Haruno: Primarily Sasuke-obsessed to focusing on becoming a stronger kunoichi, particularly in the field of medical ninjutsu. She grapples with Sasuke's betrayal and the weight of her feelings for him, while also recognizing Naruto's growth and dedication. Ultimately, she dedicates herself to training with Tsunade, evolving into a powerful medic-nin and a reliable member of Team 7. Over time, Sakura became more mature as she developed a mutual friendship with her teammates. As her core, Sakura is compassionate, determined and courageous, willing to sacrifice herself and combat those she knows to be superior to her to defend her team. 

Ino Yamanaka: Since her childhood, Ino has been a confident, friendly, bold and outspoken girl, sometimes lashing out at others if their personal habits bother her. She is generally more motivated than her team-mates Shikamaru Nara and Chōji Akimichi and tends to take charge of them.While she initially harbors a strong crush on Sasuke, she demonstrates a degree of maturity and independence she is less obsessed with Sasuke, focusing more on her ninja duties and her relationships with her teammates and friends. She becomes more confident, compassionate, and assertive, and her rivalry with Sakura softens. 

Hinata hyuga: Timid, soft-spoken, thoughtful, polite and very shy, often using appropriate name suffixes. She is kind, a trait that Neji used to consider a flaw, and dislikes competing and fighting. Possibly as a result of her father's contempt for her, Hinata lacks self-confidence, but is very hard working. After Sasuke leaves the village and Naruto departs for training with Jiraiya, Hinata Hyuga's personality remains consistent with her established character traits. She continues to be shy, thoughtful, and kind, with a strong sense of loyalty and a deep admiration for Naruto. While she lacks self-confidence, she possesses inner strength and a willingness to protect those she cares about. 

Tenten: Tenten exhibits a distaste for weakness or being overly dependent on other people. Though she can be quite fierce at times, Tenten is kind and caring toward others, comforting her friends when they are going through a hard time.During the time she train she would have continued to hone her weaponry skills, similar to how her teammates trained in their respective areas. She is likely more laid-back and enjoys her days off from missions.
